name: EmberSign
subtitle: On-device signing and tweak injection
description: Development releases of EmberSign for iOS.

apps.name: EmberSign
apps.subtitle: Apple Accounts, IPA signing and JIT tools
apps.localizedDescription: EmberSign signs IPAs using imported certificates or Apple Account provisioning, supports multiple saved Apple Accounts, compatible tweak injection, pairing-file management, JIT preparation, paired-device app inventory, best-effort app refresh, experimental Apple Watch installation, tracked Watch re-signing and GitHub update downloads, and error diagnostics with online lookup. Apple Watch installation and background refresh require real-device testing and an active pairing tunnel.
